summary: BUG-0170: Avoid rewriting an already exact private SMB mount credential. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Internal credential replay optimization preserves operator workflows, permissions, errors and recovery.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Existing credential handoff, Core reconciliation and receipt/error results remain; no Controller/Core or client-facing schema changes.

roadmap.reason: Current storage reliability acceptance remains open; no scope expansion.

state.reason: No new durable state or setting is introduced. Existing Core credential records and master pool storage registrations retain their existing inventory/adoption behavior; this change only avoids rewriting a verified existing file.

verification.method: Original source failed the inode replay regression through an isolated Go overlay; fixed full vmhost and agent normal/race suites passed. Independent source review accepted the exact-mode correction. Six-guest SMB writes, reboot hashes, lock exclusion/release, preservation and cleanup passed on the combined clean build; health observation retained two distinct unattributed member repository deadlines before writes. Wrong-owner mutation test explicitly skipped locally without root. Reliability and hosted CI remain pending.
